newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares rise on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares rise on positive sentiment.

text.p: Shares in German telecommunications group Deutsche Telekom AG advanced strongly in early electronic trade on Friday, continuing a strong performance seen in the latter part of this week.
The share rose one mark, or 2.72 percent, to 37.70 marks, compared to the overall IBIS DAX index which was up 1.31 percent at 3,289.59 points.
Dealers said the market was focusing on Telekom as the share, which was floated in November, had been neglected somewhat during the recent record run for DAX blue-chip stocks.
Telekom was the heaviest traded stock on Thursday and one of the few market gainers in the afternoon as the market fell more than two percent.

Also helping boost sentiment in Telekom stock early on was a magazine report that the group is budgeting for current year earnings per share nearly 20 percent ahead of the existing consensus of analyst expectations.

The magazine Capital, which said it had gained access to internal financial planning documents prepared by Telekom financial chief Joachim Kroeske, said the group was forecasting earnings per share 18 percent above those forecast by the major banks for this year.
